items.html: And we must understand why these hairs are drawn along the back and not along the face, or above, on top of the head itself, in the middle of his head. Moreover, it was explained above that ZA does not begin except from the navel of the heart of Arich Anpin and below; and if so, how do those strands spread until the tops of the shoulders, when it would have been proper for them to spread down to the navel of the heart, so that they would draw influence into the head of ZA, which begins there?
